crossRefs.note: Don’t befriend a hot-tempered man, and don’t associate with one who harbors anger:
lest you learn his ways, and ensnare your soul.
Like a city that is broken down and without walls is a man whose spirit is without restraint.
An angry man stirs up strife, and a wrathful man abounds in sin.
Then Saul’s anger burned against Jonathan, and he said to him, “You son of a perverse rebellious woman, don’t I know…
For as long as the son of Jesse lives on the earth, you will not be established, nor will your kingdom. Therefore now…
Saul said to his servants who stood around him, “Hear now, you Benjamites! Will the son of Jesse give everyone of you…
He said to David, “You are more righteous than I; for you have done good to me, whereas I have done evil to you.
Then Saul said, “I have sinned. Return, my son David; for I will no more do you harm, because my life was precious in…
When king David came to Bahurim, behold, a man of the family of Saul’s house came out, whose name was Shimei, the son…
He cast stones at David, and at all the servants of king David, and all the people and all the mighty men were on his…

translations.web: A hot-tempered man must pay the penalty, for if you rescue him, you must do it again.
translations.bsb: A man of great anger must pay the penalty; if you rescue him, you will have to do so again.
translations.kjv: A man of great wrath shall suffer punishment: for if thou deliver him, yet thou must do it again.
translations.asv: A man of great wrath shall bear the penalty; For if thou deliver him, thou must do it yet again.
